curated.plain_english: (1) These Rules may be called Companies (Issue of Global Depository Receipts) Rules, 2014. (2) They shall come into force on the 1st day of April, 2014. Definitions

curated.summary: Rule 7: The proceeds of issues of depository receipts shall either be remitted to a bank account in India or
curated.plain_english: deposited in an Indian bank operating abroad or any foreign bank (which is a Scheduled Bank under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934) having operations in India with an agreement that the foreign bank having operations in India shall take responsibility for furnishing all the information which may be required and in the event of a sponsored issue of Depository Receipts, the proceeds of the sale shall be credited to the respective bank account of the shareholders.
